Liquidia Corporation (LQDA) announced a global settlement agreement with **United Therapeutics Corporation (UTHR)**, resolving **six lawsuits** and **years of patent fight**. This settlement removes a major overhang and legal risk for Liquidia, allowing the company to focus on the commercialization of **YUTREPIA**. The market reacted positively, with LQDA stock **surging 40%** in after-hours trading, reflecting the enhanced clarity and stability for the company's core product and revenue stream.

gappers.analysis_details:
• **Impact**
GlobalFoundries (GF) has forged a **significant interposer deal with TSMC**, aiming to **reshape the US AI supply chain** by extending capabilities from **CoWoS to HBM**. This partnership is complemented by GF's strategic move to revive **7nm-class ambitions** through an **EUV-free FD-SOI bet** targeting the burgeoning **physical AI** market. These developments highlight GF's commitment to advanced manufacturing and critical AI infrastructure.

• **Strategic Value**
The **TSMC-GF interposer deal** signals a structural change in the **US AI supply chain**, positioning GF as a key player in high-demand areas like **HBM integration**. The **EUV-free FD-SOI approach** for **7nm-class chips** for **physical AI** further diversifies GF's technology roadmap, potentially expanding its Total Addressable Market and reducing reliance on traditional EUV lithography for advanced nodes. This move could attract more high-value AI design wins.
